chapter_title: Vitamin-M & I Cannot Remember My Mother
summary: Unit 4 pairs the story 'Vitamin-M' with Rabindranath Tagore's poem 'I Cannot Remember My Mother'. 'Vitamin-M' explores intergenerational dynamics as a young boy named Ravi shadows his aging grandfather, discovering his desire for dignity and independence. Tagore's poem captures the enduring emotional connection between a child and his deceased mother through subtle sensory memories of lullabies, autumn flowers, and the sky.

hotspots.title: Auditory Branch
hotspots.description: An old lullaby tune floating over playthings evokes his mother's care.

hotspots.title: Olfactory Branch
hotspots.description: Fragrance of Shiuli flowers in autumn morning temple worship.

hotspots.title: Visual Branch
hotspots.description: Serene blue sky from his bedroom window conveys her peaceful gaze.

key_takeaways: Elderly caregiving must balance physical safety with respect for independence.
Vitamin-M symbolizes Mindfulness and Motivation required for active aging.
Love and memory transcend physical presence through sensory triggers in nature.
